dog.description_text:
Meet Winston

Winston is a sweet boy who has already survived something no dog should ever have to experience.

Winston was found abandoned alongside Willow and Wesley, the three of them left together in a carrier outside during a brutal Nor’easter in New York. While the storm raged around them, these three dogs were left exposed to the cold and elements with nowhere to go and no one coming to protect them.

When they were found, all three were in heartbreaking condition. Their hair was severely matted, they were suffering from painful skin infections, and they had maggots. It is difficult to imagine how long they had been suffering or how frightened and uncomfortable they must have been.

But Winston held on.

He made it through that terrible night, and now he has a chance at the life he should have had all along. A life with warmth, comfort, regular care, and people who will never leave him behind.

We cannot change what happened to Winston, but we can make sure his future is filled with kindness. He deserves a soft bed, gentle hands, and a family who will cherish him and remind him every day that he is finally safe.

Winston has already endured the storm. Now we want to help him find the sunshine.

Please consider opening your heart and home to this deserving boy. He has been through enough. Now he deserves to know what it feels like to be loved.

Please remember that adoption bios are only a snapshot of each animal. They are meant to give you a glimpse into their personality and story, but there is so much more to learn.

Please reach out to our Adoption Team for additional information about Winston and to learn if he may be the right fit for your home.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Please note that the listed location for this dog may not be accurate due to technical limitations of this database and we have transportation options available within 6 hours of NYC (so don't let location hold you back)!

Interested in fostering or adopting? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.

Adoption Application: https://nycsecondchancerescue.org/dog-adoption-application

Upcoming Adoption Events: https://nycsecondchancerescue.org/adoption-events
